name: SIBS API Commerce
description: SIBS payment gateway for Drupal Commerce. Payment fulfillment is API-verified: onReturn and the status endpoint re-fetch the payment status from SIBS's API server-side and only complete the order when the API reports 'Success' (no forged fulfillment). Minor caveat: the status route is public (_access TRUE) and discloses payment status by guessable order_id — add an ownership check.
